text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: You look sleepy. Is something up?
You look sleepy. Is something up?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Nothing special. I've just been doing 
maintenance on my horseshoes these past 
few days.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Both feet wear down quickly, after all. 
If I neglect them, I can't put on a 
thrilling race."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If it means not being able to quench this 
thirst... I'd honestly rather not sleep at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was so obsessed with the competition 
that she hadn't slept for days...
